svg.title: Release timeline — 112 releases in 28 days
svg.desc: One horizontal lane per project, ordered by release count. Each dot is a published release, positioned by date across the last 28 days. yBlocks: 50, yAnimationPlayground: 16, yLookbook: 15, yReel: 6, yPulse: 5, yPhotos: 5, yAssets: 4, yGenshinColor: 4, yStage: 2, yMotion: 2, yIcon: 1, yTemplate: 1, yClip: 1.
svg.text: one dot = one published release · lane order by count · hue matches the project across every surface
